0.text: develop-templates is a collection of Nix flake templates for development environments. Each template provides a flake.nix and the project files needed to start work in an empty directory. The flake is published on FlakeHub.
0.title: develop-templates

1.text:
# Register an alias (optional)
nix registry add beans "github:nixcafe/develop-templates"

# Initialize a template
nix flake init -t beans#node

# Enter the development shell
nix develop Without the alias: nix flake init -t "github:nixcafe/develop-templates#node" --refresh Replace node with any template name from the table below.

3.title: Repository layout

4.text: Run nix flake init in an empty directory. The template name is the directory name under templates/ in the develop-templates repository.
4.title: Quick Start

5.text: nix flake init -t "github:nixcafe/develop-templates#node" --refresh Replace node with another template name. The --refresh flag makes Nix fetch the latest revision of the repository.
5.title: Direct flake reference

6.text:
Register the repository once in your Nix registry to use a shorter reference: nix registry add beans "github:nixcafe/develop-templates"
nix flake init -t beans#node After registration, beans#<name> can be used anywhere the full github:nixcafe/develop-templates#<name> reference is accepted.
6.title: Registry alias

7.text: If you use cattery-modules and enable its shared Nix module, it registers beans in the Nix registry. You can skip nix registry add and run: nix flake init -t beans#node
7.title: With cattery-modules

8.text: nix develop This starts a shell with the tools listed in the template table. Most templates also include a .envrc, so direnv allow works if direnv is installed.
8.title: After initialization

9.text: The available names are nix, node, python, rust, java, kotlin, latex, typst, nix-config, colmena-config, secrets, purr, and purr-flake-parts. The flake does not define a default template, so nix flake init -t beans fails. Pass a name explicitly: nix flake init -t beans#nix
9.title: Template names

10.text: The templates/ directory contains 13 templates. The directory name is the template name passed to nix flake init -t.

13.title: How Templates Work

14.text: This project follows GitHub Flow. Make changes on a feature branch and open a pull request against the main branch.
14.title: Contributing

15.text:
git clone https://github.com/nixcafe/develop-templates.git
cd develop-templates
nix develop The dev shell provides nixfmt, deadnix, and statix. It also installs the git-hooks hooks, so formatting and linting run when you commit. Run the checks manually with: nix flake check
15.title: Development Shell

17.title: Adding a New Nix Template

18.text: The workflow in .github/workflows/flake-check.yml runs nix flake check on pull requests to main. The workflow in .github/workflows/flakehub-publish-rolling.yml publishes each push to main to FlakeHub as nixcafe/develop-templates with rolling versioning.
18.title: CI

19.text: The main branch is protected: Pull requests require at least one approval.Status checks must pass before merging.New commits dismiss stale reviews.
19.title: Branch Protection
